thread:
incident-bot: 🚨 P0: Quality regression detected - smart-routing policy 'cost-saver-v3' diverted traffic to q4-small variant in us-west-2. Alerts: embedding mismatch + increased hallucination reports from customers. Pager triggered to #incidents and oncall.

jessica (oncall-sre): I'm on pager. Observing spike in error-rate-ish signals? latency fine, but APDEX down for several customers. Any deploys to routing in the last hour?

mike (eng-ml): Not from model infra side in last 2h. We did push a policy tweak to cost-saver-v3 at 1812342500 (automated rollout to 10%). Change was promoting 'q4-small' as compatible fallback to reduce cost. We didn't anticipate it matching for long prompts.

sam (infra-ops): I can see the gating rule that expanded compatibility: `allow_if_latency<200 && model_cost_ratio<0.6`. Looks like it started matching for long-convo requests due to a bug in context-length evaluation. Debugging now.

tara (support-lead): We have 4 open tickets mentioning increased nonsense / hallucinations from the last 30m. One large customer (acme-corp) reported production regression affecting chat summaries.

anna (pm): We're in a customer-facing incident. Prioritize mitigation. What's the blast radius and ETA to stop bad traffic?

jessica (oncall-sre): Immediate mitigation plan: 1) disable cost-saver-v3 policy 2) re-route active traffic to stable-highq variant 3) roll back policy change in config store. I'll run steps 1 and 2 now.

deploy-bot: Deploy started by jessica: POST /api/route/policy/disable cost-saver-v3 -> job 6543

jessica (oncall-sre): Running command to disable policy:
```
curl -X POST "https://control-plane.internal/v1/policies/disable" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SRE_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"policy_id":"cost-saver-v3"}'
```

jessica (oncall-sre): Policy disable returned 202 accepted. Verifying traffic shift.

sam (infra-ops): I added a temporary override to pin route for high-value tenants:
```
routing.override.add({
  "selector":"tenant:acme-corp",
  "model_variant":"stable-highq-2.1",
  "priority":1000
})
```

mike (eng-ml): Good. Also adding a fallback blocklist so cost-based rules don't match long-context requests: `if prompt_tokens > 2048 -> skip cost_saver`.

tara (support-lead): Pinged acme-corp support contact and let them know we're mitigating. They reported fewer bad responses after 30s.

jessica (oncall-sre): Observability: hallucination alerts dropped to baseline in ~90s after disable. APDEX for affected customers trending back up. Rolling metrics:
- 10m window: incorrect_response_rate went from 6.2% -> 0.8%
- p95 latency unchanged

anna (pm): Thanks — need a short post-incident summary for customers and execs. Tara, can you draft a customer note: what happened, what we changed, and next steps to prevent recurrence?

tara (support-lead): On it. Drafting now. Will include timeline and remediation. Also asking for impact matrix: customers affected, duration, severity.

mike (eng-ml): Root cause so far: policy compatibility predicate used sampled token estimate that undercounted long prompts. That made q4-small eligible when it shouldn't have. We'll patch the predicate and add a coverage test in eval harness.

sam (infra-ops): Action items I took: disabled policy, applied tenant overrides, and pushed a hotfix to the routing-service to ignore partial token estimates until validated. Change id: rs-hotfix-189.

deploy-bot: Hotfix rs-hotfix-189 deployed to us-west-2 (canary 20% -> success) by sam

jessica (oncall-sre): Handoff: I'm handing over to sam for the next 2 hours for follow-up and monitoring. If anything spikes, please page me. Next on-call: @mike picks up at 1812349000.

sam (infra-ops): Taking over monitoring. Setting alert thresholds tighter for the next 2h and keeping policy disabled until we have a validated predicate.

mike (eng-ml): I'll follow up with a PR to add regression tests in the routing evaluation harness and a canary plan for re-enabling cost-saver-v3 with stricter predicates.

tara (support-lead): Customer comms go out in 15m. Notifying acme-corp, two other customers, and posting a brief note to status.redwood.ai

anna (pm): Also schedule a blameless postmortem tomorrow 10:00am PT. Invite SRE, Eng-ML, Infra, Support, and Product.

jessica (oncall-sre): TL;DR: cost-based routing policy misapplied to long prompts -> low-quality variant returned -> page triggered -> policy disabled and high-q overrides applied -> metrics recovered. Handoff to sam for monitoring.

sam (infra-ops): Confirming last check: incorrect_response_rate = 0.9% (baseline 0.7%), affected active tenants 3 -> now 0. Reopening if anything new.

deploy-bot: Incident marked 'mitigated' by jessica at 1812346225

jessica (oncall-sre): Closing the pager for now. We'll keep tracking. Postmortem please include: how policy predicates are validated, canary thresholds, and a checklist for customer-impacting routing changes.

tara (support-lead): Uploaded customer impact spreadsheet to /shared/incidents/1812345678/impacts.csv

anna (pm): Thanks team. Assigning owners: eng-ml -> fix predicate + tests (mike), infra -> improve canary gating + config safety (sam), SRE -> update runbook (jessica), support -> customer comms and RCA prep (tara).

mike (eng-ml): I'll start the PR and include a synthetic eval set focused on long contexts. ETA EOD.

sam (infra-ops): Monitoring notes saved. If all stable by EOD, we'll plan a controlled re-enable with extra telemetry.

jessica (oncall-sre): Handed off done. I'm back on rotation but out of the loop unless pages come in. Good job everyone :thumbsup!
